decisions.statement: A run is read against the ceiling of the group the caller names.
The seconds counted are the run's own together with the seconds the run spawned.
A run at its ceiling is under that ceiling.
A group stating no ceiling answers nothing however long its run took.
The answer names the page of the check that ran.
A check reaches here as its slug, its page and its ceilings rather than whole.
Nothing here runs a check, measures a run or stops one part way through.

definition: what a run was allowed to spend, and what a run spending over that answers
